meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 它会先检查 OneCLI 是否已配置。若没配置好,安装网关/CLI,把 `.env` 里的 Anthropic 等密钥迁入 Agent Vault 并删掉原 key;没有可迁密钥时引导你注册。最后重建并重启 NanoClaw,核对 OneCLI 是否生效。
howto.when: 在 `/update-nanoclaw` 把 OneCLI 作为破坏性变更引入之后,或首次配置 OneCLI 时触发;你说“初始化 OneCLI”“迁移 .env 凭证”等也会让它接管。

say.text: 初始化 OneCLI 并迁移 .env 里的密钥
say.note: 检测现状后安装配置并迁移。

say.note: 创建对应条目并从 .env 删除原值。

howto.what_en: Checks for an existing OneCLI setup. If missing, installs gateway/CLI, moves `.env` Anthropic keys into Agent Vault and deletes them from `.env`; without keys, guides fresh registration. Then rebuilds/restarts NanoClaw and verifies.
howto.when_en: Runs after `/update-nanoclaw` brings OneCLI in as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup; also when the user asks to initialize OneCLI or migrate credentials.

say_en.text: Initialize OneCLI and migrate keys from .env
say_en.note: Checks current state, then installs/configures and migrates.

say_en.text: I updated NanoClaw and need to initialize OneCLI
say_en.note: Checks whether it's configured, then installs and migrates as needed.
Creates a secret and removes the raw key from .env.
